outputs.discrepancies: The caption lists the antibody set as 'EPR5526, 2B7-4C9, 4E10-3E10, 138-129', but the heatmap row label in the panel reads '138-139' (matching the antibodies '138' and '139' shown in panel A), not '138-129'.

The caption describes all violin plots uniformly as 'log2 enrichment ratio (HTT IP vs mIgG IP)', but the right-hand plot (D7F7 antibody) is labeled on its y-axis as 'Abundance vs. rIgG (Log2)', i.e., compared to rabbit IgG rather than mouse IgG (mIgG) as stated generally in the caption.

The caption states there are only three marker categories (red = Bait HTT, orange = selected positive controls, light blue = proteins annotated in ≥2/3 of prior HTT IP-MS studies), but the panel's legend shows four categories ('HTT', '2/3 AP-MS', 'Consortium', '++') with colors (red, teal/green, blue, orange) that do not clearly map onto the three categories described. In particular, the 'Consortium' category shown in the legend is not mentioned or explained anywhere in the caption.
